create_compressed_tensors_w4a8_fp8: create a CompressedTensorsW4A8Fp8 quantization scheme with group size 128 for W4A8 FP8 quantization
create_weights_quantized_layer: create weights for a W4A8 FP8 quantized layer with packed int4 weights and group quantization scales
apply_weights_forward: apply W4A8 FP8 quantized weights to run the forward pass of a layer with input tensor and optional bias
process_weights_after_loading: process and repack weights after loading from compressed-tensors checkpoint format for the kernel
get_min_capability_hopper: get the minimum GPU capability (90, Hopper) required to use the W4A8 FP8 quantization kernel
